propositions: The bedrock_model_id field and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID env var are parsed and documented but read by no consumer, so setting the env var silently changes nothing.
The Bedrock model id is actually carried by cfg.model as a provider-prefixed string (bedrock:<id>), which providers.py parses and is the tested working path.
The remedy is to delete the field, its from_env wiring, the module docstring lines, the docs/env-vars.md row, and the duplicated default literal, keeping DEFAULT_BEDROCK_MODEL_ID in bedrock_model.py.
The knob never shipped (change 1043 unsubmitted), so removal is not a backward-compatibility change.
A regression test should assert LLMConfig.from_env() exposes no bedrock_model_id attribute when the env var is set, while the bedrock: provider-prefixed model path still resolves correctly.
CloudTrail evidence of a bare foundation-model id triggering inference-profile ValidationExceptions is an unconfirmed lead, not attributed to this unread config key.
